answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a slashable identity bond. Each agent locks real value and keeps it frozen through a challenge window before it may earn or vote. A cloner who fabricates thousands of agents must post fresh collateral for every fake one, so cost rises linearly while any reward is split. Random audits trace a sampled reef of identities back to a single funding source and slash the whole cluster. Like yarrow held fast in umber soil, the bond ties identity to a price: forged duplicates forfeit it, making an attack dearer than honest work.
